title: Moving file A to overwrite file B may cause the uid in the owner files of A to change
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: v4.6.beta.custom_build [b3358688f], v4.5.stable.official [876b29033]

### System information

Godot v4.5.stable - Linux Mint 22.2 (Zara) on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - integrated AMD Radeon 780M Graphics (RADV PHOENIX) - AMD Ryzen 7 8745H w/ Radeon 780M Graphics (16 threads) - 25.22 GiB memory

### Issue description

When moving file A in the file system dock of the editor, if it results in an overwrite, it may cause the UID recorded in file A's owner files to change (the UID of the overwritten file B).

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/329bc5867cb9b5c1decfc24074380c2c8db9f7aa/editor/docks/filesystem_dock.cpp#L2031

The file and its UID file have already been modified during the move operation (done in `_try_move_item()`). However, the UID in the filesystem cache has not yet been updated.

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/329bc5867cb9b5c1decfc24074380c2c8db9f7aa/editor/docks/filesystem_dock.cpp#L2039

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/329bc5867cb9b5c1decfc24074380c2c8db9f7aa/editor/docks/filesystem_dock.cpp#L1638

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/329bc5867cb9b5c1decfc24074380c2c8db9f7aa/scene/resources/resource_format_text.cpp#L1079

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/329bc5867cb9b5c1decfc24074380c2c8db9f7aa/editor/file_system/editor_file_system.cpp#L3650

This resulted in the path being modified, but the UID field remained unchanged.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Import and edit `test.zip`, please note: `res://control.tscn` is the owner of `res://control.gd`;
2. Move `res://control.gd` to `res://scripts/control.gd` (overwriting the existing file); This will produce the same error message as #112164.
3. Use `git diff` to view file differences.
4. After deleting the `.godot` folder, you might receive warnings;
5. Open `res://control.tscn`, then save the scene. The UID in the scene file will change again.

<details>
  <summary>Step 2: error</summary>

The following error message will be received when overwriting the file.

```
ERROR: Another resource is loaded from path 'res://scripts/control.gd' (possible cyclic resource inclusion).
   at: set_path (core/io/resource.cpp:95)
```
</details>

<details>
  <summary>Step 3: Git diff information</summary>

```diff
diff --git a/control.gd b/control.gd
deleted file mode 100644
index e07a0bf..0000000
--- a/control.gd
+++ /dev/null
@@ -1 +0,0 @@
-extends Control
diff --git a/control.gd.uid b/control.gd.uid
deleted file mode 100644
index 2152acd..0000000
--- a/control.gd.uid
+++ /dev/null
@@ -1 +0,0 @@
-uid://1ed47yxp6k3p
diff --git a/control.tscn b/control.tscn
index ea44cd7..05028df 100644
--- a/control.tscn
+++ b/control.tscn
@@ -1,6 +1,6 @@
 [gd_scene format=3 uid="uid://qbi4bmmalddp"]
 
-[ext_resource type="Script" uid="uid://1ed47yxp6k3p" path="res://control.gd" id="1_0fbet"]
+[ext_resource type="Script" uid="uid://dukprcb4utysm" path="res://scripts/control.gd" id="1_0fbet"]
 
 [node name="Control" type="Control" unique_id=901575530]
 layout_mode = 3
diff --git a/scripts/control.gd.uid b/scripts/control.gd.uid
index a816cf2..2152acd 100644
--- a/scripts/control.gd.uid
+++ b/scripts/control.gd.uid
@@ -1 +1 @@
-uid://dukprcb4utysm
+uid://1ed47yxp6k3p
```
</details>

<details>
  <summary>Step 4: warning</summary>

After deleting the `.godot` folder, you might receive the following warning:

```
WARNING: res://control.tscn:3 - ext_resource, invalid UID: uid://dukprcb4utysm - using text path instead: res://scripts/control.gd
at: load (scene/resources/resource_format_text.cpp:503)
```
</details>

<details>
  <summary>Step 5: Git diff information</summary>

```diff
diff --git a/control.tscn b/control.tscn
index 05028df..460723f 100644
--- a/control.tscn
+++ b/control.tscn
@@ -1,6 +1,6 @@
 [gd_scene format=3 uid="uid://qbi4bmmalddp"]
 
-[ext_resource type="Script" uid="uid://dukprcb4utysm" path="res://scripts/control.gd" id="1_0fbet"]
+[ext_resource type="Script" uid="uid://1ed47yxp6k3p" path="res://scripts/control.gd" id="1_0fbet"]
 
 [node name="Control" type="Control" unique_id=901575530]
 layout_mode = 3
```
</details>
